title: The Atlas of Port Mahon
author: Ulyana Okonkwo
blurb: Lior Thornbury, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
